title: Sound-box mats (3-box + 4-box)
cut: Cut into 2 mats along the dotted lines (55 mm boxes, 6 mm gutters).
howToPrint: Print 1 sheet single-sided at 100% on card — it comes 2-up, one 3-box mat and one 4-box mat.

title: Chain board
cut: One cut: trim the board out on the dotted rectangle.
howToPrint: Print 1 sheet single-sided at 100% on card, trim to the dotted rectangle, matt-laminate.

title: Chain cards ×6
cut: Cut 6 A6 cards (105 × 148.5 mm) on the dotted rectangles.
howToPrint: Print 6 pages DUPLEX, flip on SHORT EDGE, 100%, 2 A6 cards per sheet.

title: Dictation flip cards ×12
cut: Cut 12 A6 cards (105 × 148.5 mm) on the dotted rectangles.
howToPrint: Print 12 pages DUPLEX, flip on SHORT EDGE, 100%, 2 A6 cards per sheet.

title: Heart-word ring cards ×5
cut: Cut 5 cards, 60 × 35 mm, then punch the amber circle.
howToPrint: Print 1 sheet single-sided at 100% on card; cut 5 cards; punch and ring them.

title: Punctuation tiles ×3
howToPrint: Print 1 sheet single-sided at 100% on the thickest card you have; cut 3 tiles; laminate.

title: Blank lined sentence strips
cut: Cut 4 strips, 200 × 60 mm — trim about 5 mm off each long edge of the sheet.
howToPrint: Print as many sheets as you need, single-sided at 100% on plain paper; cut 4 strips per sheet.

title: Picture-sequence sets ×4 (16 cards)
cut: Cut 16 cards, 90 × 90 mm, four per sheet.
howToPrint: Print 8 pages DUPLEX, flip on SHORT EDGE, 100%; one story set per sheet, 4 cards each.

title: Blank fold-book template
cut: One cut, along the amber line in the middle of the sheet.
howToPrint: Print single-sided at 100% (never 'fit to page'); one sheet = one 8-page book.

title: Story-dictation sheet
howToPrint: Print 20 copies single-sided at 100% on plain paper; put them in a folder.

title: Teacher script card
cut: Trim to the dotted A5 rectangle (about 6 mm in from the sheet edge).
howToPrint: Print 1 page at 100% on A5 card, or on A4 and trim; laminate.

title: Grammar symbol tokens
cut: Cut 18 shapes: 6 black triangles (35 mm base), 6 red circles (30 mm), 6 dark-blue triangles (25 mm base).
howToPrint: Print 1 sheet single-sided at 100% on thick card, laminate the whole sheet, then cut the shapes out.

title: Grammar control cards ×6
cut: Cut 6 cards, 200 × 60 mm, three per sheet.
howToPrint: Print 2 pages single-sided at 100% on card; cut 3 strips per sheet; laminate.
